description: The set of distinct [assignment] entities resolved from a single composite document's numbered entries.

entities.description: One element per resolved [assignment] entity in this composite document. Cluster the document's entries into distinct real-world entities, emitting one element per entity with its canonical field values and the entries that mention it. Two elements may not share all of their entity-field values.

items.description: A single element of the array.

entity_id.description: Sequential integer identifying this resolved entity within the composite document, starting at 1 and increasing by 1 with no gaps.

assignment_type.description:
The kind of assignment. Allowed values:
- internal: An assignment internal to the organization.
- external: An assignment external to the organization.
- other: An assignment that is neither internal nor external.

entry_nums.description: The entry numbers (the [Entry N] markers in the composite document) that refer to this entity. Every entry in the document must be assigned to exactly one entity: assign every entry, never invent an entry number that is not in the document, and never assign the same entry to more than one entity.

items.description: A single integer element of the array.
